why: The Wessex Cup is named in ¶4 and ¶18 as the race Silver Blaze was favourite for.
¶18 says Silver Blaze is from the Isonomy stock, his famous ancestor.
¶18 mentions the racing public, with whom the horse has always been a prime favourite.

text: Next Tuesday, at the fall of the flag
why: ¶18 refers to 'the fall of the flag next Tuesday', the start of the race.
